reportTitle: INSAaf AI — Maximum Verified Pakistan Law + Case-Law Corpus Coverage Matrix
methodology: Additive corpus expansion over the pre-existing RAG corpus. Baseline verified from the previous index (20 documents / 335 chunks). New documents authored as provision-preserving digests citing pakistancode.gov.pk and official bodies; every record carries provenance. Provision numbering preserved via [SECTION: n] / [ARTICLE: n] markers. No existing record deleted; checksums and index regenerated via npm run rag:build.
disclaimer: Coverage is "maximum verified publicly accessible coverage obtained from the searched authoritative sources" — NOT all Pakistani law. Full-text statutes beyond digest scope, provincial acts and High Court case law remain gaps (marked PARTIAL/MISSING). Case-law entries are digests requiring verification against official reporters before citation.

provision_status.current: All indexed statute digests target CURRENT consolidated provisions
provision_status.historical: NOT tracked — historical consolidations not ingested (marked UNKNOWN where amendment history was unclear)
provision_status.repealed: Repeal notes captured inside digests where known (e.g. Arbitration Act 1940 superseded by Arbitration Act 2024 for new arbitrations)
provision_status.unknown: Any provision whose status could not be verified is flagged in its digest text; no repealed text is mixed into CURRENT digests

missing_domains: full text of major provincial acts

case_law_gaps.note: High Court coverage is the single largest missing area; only SC/FSC digests exist. Full official judgment text ingestion requires network retrieval from court portals.

url_health.note: Status is the last observed classification; URLs are re-checked only by `npm run corpus:audit -- --check-urls` over the network.

rag_capabilities.exact_section_retrieval: ENABLED (15.0 exact / 8.0 substring boosts; numeric keys domain-scoped)
rag_capabilities.semantic_retrieval: DISABLED_OFFLINE (0 non-zero vectors in index; both GEMINI_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY in .env are currently invalid/unfunded)
rag_capabilities.case_retrieval: ENABLED (case-name + domain routing; landmark fundamental-rights judgments surfaced for rights case queries)
rag_capabilities.case_similarity: PARTIAL (fact-pattern routing to relevant statute/procedure/remedy digests; dedicated similarity vectors require semantic embeddings)

update_system.audit: corpus:audit script (detects manifest/index drift, missing files, checksum mismatches, new/removed records)
update_system.update: corpus:update script (regenerates index for changed documents only)
update_system.versioning: manifest version field + legalStatus per document; additive records only

quality.unverified_provision_status: Flagged per digest where amendment history unknown
quality.provenance_coverage: 100% of documents carry sourceURL/sourceDomain/jurisdiction/legalStatus; source URLs classified in source_registry.json; network re-probe pending
